A bare Devin install found zero of 107 skills

Devin CLI 3000.10.27 checks a plugin root for a manifest in this order: .devin-plugin/plugin.json, then .claude-plugin/plugin.json, then root plugin.json. Before this PR the repo root only had the last one, the Agent Plugins manifest, which fixes skills at a root skills directory this repo does not have. A plain devin plugins install yonatangross/orchestkit found the manifest and stopped there.

76 skills, counted with grep. Installing the subpath directly, or a bare install once this PR ships the root level .devin-plugin/plugin.json skills mapping, both reach this list.

Why 76, not 107

The other 31 skills all declare a triggers frontmatter key shaped as an object with keywords, examples, and anti-triggers. Devin's own triggers field expects a flat list, [user, model], and the shape mismatch drops the whole skill instead of warning. A controlled test confirmed the cause: renaming only that one key on a copy of auto/SKILL.md moved the count from 76 to 77, with auto now listed.

Renaming that key also touches scripts/eval/eval-coverage.sh, tests/skills/triggering/test-trigger-keywords.sh, and the SKILL_ONLY allowlist in tests/plugins/test-command-frontmatter-passthrough.sh, so it stays a tracked follow up on GH 4146 rather than a bulk edit inside this PR.
